About me

I’m studying B.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering at Ramdeobaba University, Nagpur. I’m drawn to frontend development because it’s where logic and design meet: the part of a product people actually see and touch.

Outside of code I design presentations, take photographs, and sew. Hackathons are where I bring both sides together, from building the interface to telling the story of the idea on stage.

I’m always learning, and I’m looking for projects and teams where I can keep growing.
